about: Chad D. Williams is an attorney who represents clients in the Denver, Colorado area. Chad Williams is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Chad Williams chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Denver Sturm College of Law and graduated in 1999. Chad Williams passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1999.
He represents clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar issues in Colorado. He also represents clients with Civil Litigation: Defense issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Chad Williams has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
